scope: Read-only review of the exact 20 portable/native/example implementation, regression and specification files in source-map.json. No canonical or candidate edits, Git, GUI or Prism calls; no repeat of the producers broad qualification gates.

resolved_findings.issue: Contradictory direct row bounds versus pixel inverse allowed an invalid jump.
resolved_findings.resolution: Local bounds validate predecessor ordering plus raw inverse at both half-open endpoints before atomic commit.

resolved_findings.issue: Contradictory spans allowed positive Page to move backward.
resolved_findings.resolution: Page uses checked indexed bounds and inverse; the exact original malformed-index body now refuses atomically.

resolved_findings.issue: Resize committed a newly exposed invalid interior row and Snapshot failed later.
resolved_findings.resolution: Every capacity-admitted visible/overscan span is validated before transition commit; hidden rows are not scanned.

independent_current_regression.scope: Exact unchanged original three test bodies replace the candidate formatted regression file to avoid duplicate declarations; runtime inputs use the copied final source3.

source_assessment: Prospective indexed profiles are committed only after checked geometry, bounded layout and final revision/endpoints checks. Capacity refusal precedes span iteration; total/header overflow, empty sources, malformed local inverse and revision drift preserve live state.

RowHeights copies a private prefix with a 64MiB storage cap, checked positive heights/overflow and bounded cancellation checks. Its O(N) preparation is explicit and separate from owner transition work.
Stable-key anchors clamp offsets when rows shrink; variable Page uses body pixel distance with at least one-row movement for tall rows. Fixed-height behavior and original fixtures remain supported.

Native runtime changes only the unused fixed fallback size-cap condition for indexed sources. Actual natural visible/overscan rectangles, panes, local coordinate and allocation limits remain enforced.

The example uses immutable per-revision procedural stable-key geometry with a period of at most four. Mode/projection assignments follow successful ReplaceSource; owner-held smoke errors reach separate worker/runtime exit checks.

native.limits: Prepared aggregates were independently recomputed read-only; no upstream dependency closure was copied. Preliminary logs remain historical, not final source qualification.

limitations: This reviewer did not independently replay Cocoa or external AX; parent owns the final source-bound integrated desktop evidence and metadata audit.

Local accessed-span checks do not certify hidden indexed rows or permit geometry mutation without a source revision. Source implementations remain responsible for complete immutable indexed semantics.

Bounded callback/work assertions do not qualify sustained latency, frame pacing, allocations or retained million-row memory. Full P6, editable/range/all-row selection, loaded projection preparation, large trees and separate human IME/VoiceOver gates remain open.
The two added report/review README files were read for scope alignment; final Prism/report ledger verification is a separate metadata review.
